originalTitle: RL in 10,000 LoC with Joseph Suarez
title: Investigating PPO Instability Under High Sample Reuse in Puffer
summary: Investigated why PPO collapses at very high sample reuse in Puffer, tracing the failure to momentum-based optimizers like Muon that ignore clipping during updates. Also drafted a refactoring guide for contributors to shorten code without losing features.
